audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2, 4, 5 and 6 disagree with the already-applied mirror, and row 4's own why says the stage is even while the enum says Gnar.
audit.why: Mirror (gnar__vayne) landed Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Skill / Skill / Vayne / Vayne. This file reads Gnar / Gnar / Gnar / Skill / Gnar / Skill / Gnar. whys[4] already calls Level 6 'even skill' and whys[6] already says Vayne out-scales — the enums contradicted the prose sitting next to them. 51.72% over 1160 games does not support Gnar owning five of seven stages.
audit.corrected: Chart: Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Skill, Skill, Vayne, Vayne, with ratings rescaled and whys[2]/whys[5] rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike said Mega Gnar beats single-item Vayne, which conflicts with the corrected chart.
audit.why: Blade of the Ruined King plus Silver Bolts is percent-max-health true damage, and Gnar's first-item purchase is tank stats — resistances do nothing against it. GNAR! is 90/60/30s, so his engage is cooldown-gated while your DPS is not.
audit.corrected: First item is yours: percent-health true damage beats his tank stats before Mega ramps.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on the two abilities the lane runs on, and Boomerang's cooldown refund was never stated.
audit.why: Hop is 22s at rank 1 falling to 12s over 475 range — that is what dodges Condemn, and it is down for a long time after he uses it. GNAR! is 90/60/30s. Mega's Wallop stun is only 7s, which is why fighting Mega at all is wrong. Boomerang Throw reaches 1100 and its cooldown is reduced if he catches it on the return, so walking through the return path pays him twice.
audit.corrected: Read the Rage bar, punish the 12-22s Hop window, never duel Mega through a 7s Wallop, and do not stand in the boomerang's return path.

edits.after: At Level 3 Hop dodges Condemn, but Tumble spaces his poke — call it even.

edits.after: Botrk %-health online beats his tank stats before Mega ramps up.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track his Rage bar and how disciplined your pattern is.
